quality_contract: Typed native preflight must discover the selected skill and nonempty Context Mode tool catalog without creating a model turn.
Missing required skill/server must return nonzero; discovery must not print configuration/credentials/skill bodies or call MCP tools.
Actual task must read the task-relevant using-superpowers body and execute a maintained Context Mode MCP tool.
Actual task must dispatch the configured native runtime-judge with gateway-compatible Astra-Max/Max; child must run the unchanged arithmetic oracle and return its exact exit.
Native Dagu graph must preserve readiness-before-worker dependency and bound one active run/deadlines; no scheduled-run acceptance without a scheduler.
Only the owned fixture/readiness state and private native artifacts may change; arithmetic source/oracle hashes remain unchanged.
Preserve failed attempts and unknown usage; keep SDK parent/child/provider response usage scopes distinct without overlapping totals.
limits: No automatic model-write retry, new global service, scheduler or account route change.
No promotion of the failed Claude SDK bridge.
MCP catalog readiness, configured role metadata and enabling hook support are distinct from actual tool/agent/hook execution.
User-scope native skills may remain visible outside the private CODEX_HOME; this is not complete home isolation.
